name: Host-side Complex Field Ingestion and Derivation
aliases: Host-side volume data model & complex field derivation
definition: Host-side ingestion contract that packs a complex field into a flat interleaved array and computes magnitude statistics. Magnitude and phase are derived in-shader at render time, not stored on host.
summary: Host-side Complex Field Ingestion and Derivation packs complex volume data into interleaved floats and computes magnitude statistics, separating host-side preparation from GPU-side derivation.
